entities.name: Query Ham1p-like protein
observations: 196 aa sequence; predicted molecular mass 20.95 kDa and theoretical pI 4.88.
Contains a Ham1p_like domain (Pfam PF01725.22) spanning residues 4–192.
Matches reviewed bacterial dITP/XTP pyrophosphatases at 55.9–56.4% identity with 99.5% query coverage and E-values of 1.5e-73 to 4.3e-73.
Homology supports EC 3.6.1.66 dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase activity, but exact substrate preference is inferred rather than directly assayed for this sequence.
Likely cytosolic and homodimeric by reference-protein annotation; these properties are homology-based.

entities.name: Bacterial dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase
observations: Reviewed homologs Q83JS0, Q8FE27, and Q8XCU5 are annotated as Mg2+-dependent dITP/XTP pyrophosphatases, EC 3.6.1.66.
The enzyme hydrolyzes noncanonical purine nucleoside triphosphates to the corresponding monophosphate and diphosphate, supporting nucleotide-pool sanitization.

entities.name: dITP hydrolysis
observations: dITP + H2O = dIMP + diphosphate + H(+); Rhea RHEA:28342.
This reaction is a curated reaction associated with the closest reviewed homologs, not a direct assay of the query sequence.

entities.name: XTP hydrolysis
observations: XTP + H2O = XMP + diphosphate + H(+); Rhea RHEA:28610.
This reaction is a curated reaction associated with the closest reviewed homologs, not a direct assay of the query sequence.

entities.name: ITP hydrolysis
observations: ITP + H2O = IMP + diphosphate + H(+); Rhea RHEA:29399.
ITP is an additional reported substrate for the homologous enzyme family; exact activity of the query protein remains unverified.

entities.name: Magnesium cofactor
observations: Reviewed homologs bind one Mg2+ ion per subunit; Mg2+ is therefore the best-supported cofactor assignment for the query by homology.
